# Test-runner pins for the Pydantic AI wheel-compat job. Same pins as
# requirements-test.txt minus openai and google-genai: the job installs the
# wheel's full pydantic-ai extra, whose provider ranges (openai>=3.8.0,
# google-genai>=2.18.0 on 2.x) conflict with those pins, and neither the
# test module nor conftest imports either package.
# Direct unit-test dependencies, pinned to the versions resolved in poetry.lock.
